desks.description: Twelve commitments for the week across product, growth, customer success, sales and ops: who owns each, what's blocked, what carried over, and what we'll show at Friday wins.
desks.brief:
## Weekly priorities — Monday kickoff to Friday wins

**Team** Mossbank · 13 people building booking software for physio clinics
**This week** 12 priorities · 28 person-days committed
**Kickoff** Monday 9:00, 15 minutes · **Wins** Friday 16:00, 30 minutes

### How the week works
One priority per person, small enough to finish by Friday. Marco keeps his week clear to review and unblock. Owners fill their rows before kickoff, so kickoff is about trade-offs, not read-outs. Anything blocked gets a named unblocker the same day. Wins are written on this desk before Friday's call, so anyone who can't join still sees them.

### This week's shape
- **Product** carries the most: the waitlist beta for five pilot clinics, plus the SMS provider move
- **Customer success** is onboarding the six clinics signed last week
- Two items carried over from last week — both are in their second week, so at Friday wins each is done, cut or split

### The one thing that matters
Waitlist beta in front of five pilot clinics this week. If something has to drop, it's the pricing page rewrite, not the beta.

callout.title: Blocked: SMS sender ID
callout.body: Lin can't finish the SMS provider move until the new provider registers our branded sender ID on the ACMA register — without it, reminders can't go out under our name. Marco is chasing. If it isn't approved by @+2d, the waitlist beta ships on the current provider. The move is already in its second week, so it's split, not carried: Lin finishes the integration this week and the cut-over waits for the sender ID.

desks.title: Clinic waitlist launch — everyone ships it together
desks.description: General release of the waitlist feature to all 180 clinics: one checklist across product, growth, customer success, sales and ops, the go/no-go criteria and the questions still open.
desks.brief:
## Clinic waitlist — general release

**Launch** @+16d to all 180 clinics · pilot with 5 clinics starting this week
**Owner** Jide (product) · every team has rows on the checklist
**Go/no-go** @+14d, 20 minutes, whole team

### What ships
When a booked slot is cancelled, the next patient on the waitlist gets an SMS and can claim it in one tap. Clinics choose how long the offer stays open.

### Why it matters
Each pilot clinic loses about 11 appointments a week to late cancellations. At a $95 average consult, filling 40% of them — the go/no-go bar — is worth about $418 a week to a clinic. That's the clearest revenue story we have for renewals — Joon has nine due this month.

### Launching together
Nobody waits for a launch meeting to find out what's left: every row has an owner, a due date and the hours remaining, and the total is on the chart. A critical row that isn't done at go/no-go moves the date.

### Where it stands
11 of 14 items still open, 49 hours of work left. Five critical items are open; the go/no-go hinges on the pilot feedback and the load test.

callout.title: Go/no-go criteria
callout.body: Go @+16d only if pilot clinics fill at least 40% of late-cancelled slots, there are no double-claimed slots, and the load test holds 180 clinics sending at once. Otherwise: ship to the 5 pilots plus 20 volunteer clinics and try again a fortnight later.

blocks.p: Jide decides product questions, Hana decides pricing, and go/no-go is a whole-team call @+14d. If a question is still open at go/no-go, we take the safer option and note it here.

notes.title: Pilot clinics — what we're watching
notes.body:
Five clinics, chosen for different shapes:

- Two single-practitioner clinics (high cancellations, no front desk)
- Two 4–6 practitioner clinics on the busiest plan
- One three-site group — Omar's multi-site trial

Amara calls each on day 3 and day 8. Questions: did the front desk notice? Did anyone claim a slot they couldn't make? Would they switch it off?
